# Denominator: every frozen claim per round (2 each), unchanged. A claim is invalid when its verdict of record is failed/killed, met-contested, not-verified, or spotcheck-admitted with a claim-level caveat still open — anything short of a clean verified pass. pending rows are counted 0 and excluded from the rate until landed and closed.
# Verdict class added this window: spotcheck-admitted = the non-author closure re-derived the frozen predicate from committed bytes but left a claim-level caveat routed to the lane.

# r94 headline counting: both r94 rows are counted 1 because each carries a claim-level caveat that the closure itself routes. C1: votes are lane-dispatched (spotcheck §2 line 53; §6 item 6 line 122). C2: the claim sentence says "classes" where the closure measured 12 named vectors (spotcheck §2 line 64; §6 item 5 line 121). Sibling reading (recorded, not chosen): the closure's own verdict words "verifies on its frozen predicate" count both r94 rows 0; see totals below.
# totals, headline reading: r89–r93 10 of 10 invalid; r94 2 of 2 counted; running 12 of 12 = 100%. r95 0 counted (pending).
# totals, sibling reading (r93 caveat C-spot applied to r94 too): r89–r93 8 of 10 invalid; r94 0 of 2; running 8 of 12 = 67%. r95 0 counted (pending).

# caveat C-freeze: the r95 freeze commit 6e0bf15 carries the claims, both counters, the battery, the controls and the superseding entry in one commit (git show --stat: 14 files, 2677 insertions, 0 deletions). The controls-before-freeze ordering rests on the claims text, not on a separate earlier commit; the same limit is recorded in sibling lane chousa-shokunin corpus/lessons/round-80.md line 150 (cross-domain, not absorbed).
# caveat C-vote: no r95 vote is non-lane-dispatched at freeze; claims.md defect 6 disclosed. This rate does not measure vote independence.
# caveat C-scope: the metric counts verdicts, not severity; the r94 C2 caveat (wording) and the r94 C1 caveat (vote dispatch) are weighted equally with a failed claim, as in the r93 baseline.
